explain_task.question: In the revised model, explain exactly why the objective increases from 38000 to 39000 even though the hired set remains G, H, and I. Your answer must trace the new net-cost terms from `src/current_heuristic.py` and `src/formulation.tex` back to the business phrases “Lead premium” and “mentorship pair,” name the exact CSV parameter names and values used (`lead_premium`, `mentor_bonus`, `min_leads`, `max_pairs`), and identify the revised code variables (`lead[c]`, `eng[c]`, `p`, `x[c]`) and constraints that make one Lead and one counted pair appear. Then use the revised LP-relaxation diagnostics to state which constraints are binding and their shadow prices/slacks (`MinSkill`, `MinLeads`, `PairLeadCap`, `Budget`), interpret the business meaning of those marginal values, and explain why you cannot linearly extrapolate the `MinLeads` or `PairLeadCap` duals to predict the integer model’s cost under a larger policy change such as requiring 2 leads or allowing more than 2 pairs.
